description.en: An OpenAI-compatible AI model gateway that aggregates free quotas from multiple providers (NVIDIA, SenseNova, ModelScope, Gemini, etc.) into one endpoint with automatic failover and quality-based routing.
description.zh: 一个 OpenAI 兼容的 AI 模型网关，把 NVIDIA、商汤、魔搭、Gemini 等多个平台的免费额度聚合成统一接口，支持自动故障转移与基于质量/延迟的加权路由。
